{{Item infobox | description = Double-click to trade [[karma]] for something useful.
Can only buy one item per day. | rarity = rare | bound = account | collection = Gobblers and Exchanges Collector | type = gizmo | id = 67270 }} The [[Karmic Converter]] is an item that allows you to trade [[karma]] for one of three items per day. Upon use, a vendor window opens which allows you to buy an item. After buying one, the list clears until the next day. The available items change every day. == Acquisition == {{achievement list|reward=Karmic Converter}} === Sold by === {{Sold by}} == Items offered == {{inventory|Karmic Converter}} == Trivia == * The item was initially unavailable in the {{item icon|Wizard's Gobbler}} due to technical limitations.[https://en-forum.guildwars2.com/topic/158751-karmic-converter-not-unlocked-inside-wizard-gobbler/#comment-2291975 Karmic Converter not unlocked inside Wizard Gobbler], en-forum.guildwars2.com It was later added with the [[Game updates/2026-11-10|November 10, 2026 game update]]. ** This also changed the mechanics of its offers from being a fixed rotation to likely being fully random. The old rotation can be found [[Karmic_Converter/Table|here]] and [[Karmic_Converter/Drop_rate|its research here]]. ** The ID of the item variants offered were changed to match the containers from similar [[gobbler]]s, allowing them to stack together. == References == {{converter nav}} [[de:Karmischer Konverter]] [[es:Conversor kármico]] [[fr:Convertisseur de karma]]
